meta.title: War Clouds Gather
meta.description: Plumes of smoke rise all around as the sound of drums and gongs fills the air.

units.rawText: Reverse Babylon Tower, the frontline.
units.displayText: Reverse Babylon Tower, the frontline.

spans.text: Reverse Babylon Tower, the frontline.

units.rawText: Huff... huff...
units.displayText: Huff... huff...

spans.text: Huff... huff...

units.rawText: For a young lady, having to breathe the acrid air upon the battlefield is a cruel form of punishment.
units.displayText: For a young lady, having to breathe the acrid air upon the battlefield is a cruel form of punishment.

spans.text: For a young lady, having to breathe the acrid air upon the battlefield is a cruel form of punishment.

units.rawText: She abhors the stench of blood and grime, despises the rusty scent of smoke and gunpowder mingling.
units.displayText: She abhors the stench of blood and grime, despises the rusty scent of smoke and gunpowder mingling.

spans.text: She abhors the stench of blood and grime, despises the rusty scent of smoke and gunpowder mingling.

units.rawText: But what she hates most is the sourness that arises in her nose when an ally's life fades away.
units.displayText: But what she hates most is the sourness that arises in her nose when an ally's life fades away.

spans.text: But what she hates most is the sourness that arises in her nose when an ally's life fades away.

units.rawText: And so, she continues to wield her axe. The further away she can get from that scent, the better.
units.displayText: And so, she continues to wield her axe. The further away she can get from that scent, the better.

spans.text: And so, she continues to wield her axe. The further away she can get from that scent, the better.

units.rawText: Kyaaaak!
units.displayText: Kyaaaak!

spans.text: Kyaaaak!

units.rawText: Get... <size=40>outta my way!</size>
units.displayText: Get... outta my way!

spans.text: Get...
outta my way!

units.rawText: Her operand-enhanced axe fails to sunder the monster's shell as expected. Before she can even be surprised, a lethal tentacle attack swings towards her, launching her away.
units.displayText: Her operand-enhanced axe fails to sunder the monster's shell as expected. Before she can even be surprised, a lethal tentacle attack swings towards her, launching her away.

spans.text: Her operand-enhanced axe fails to sunder the monster's shell as expected. Before she can even be surprised, a lethal tentacle attack swings towards her, launching her away.

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: (Coughing) Ack!
units.displayText: (Coughing) Ack!

spans.text: (Coughing) Ack!

units.rawText: Averting major injury with a timely shield activation, the sheer force in that blow still propels her into the ruins on the other side as rubble digs into her back.
units.displayText: Averting major injury with a timely shield activation, the sheer force in that blow still propels her into the ruins on the other side as rubble digs into her back.

spans.text: Averting major injury with a timely shield activation, the sheer force in that blow still propels her into the ruins on the other side as rubble digs into her back.

units.rawText: Already starting to run dry, huh...
units.displayText: Already starting to run dry, huh...

spans.text: Already starting to run dry, huh...

units.rawText: Tch, if I need just a bit more...
units.displayText: Tch, if I need just a bit more...

spans.text: Tch, if I need just a bit more...

units.rawText: Knocked to the ground, the Intermediate Sanctifier concocts a plan as she reaches for her weapon, preparing to spring back to her feet.
units.displayText: Knocked to the ground, the Intermediate Sanctifier concocts a plan as she reaches for her weapon, preparing to spring back to her feet.

spans.text: Knocked to the ground, the Intermediate Sanctifier concocts a plan as she reaches for her weapon, preparing to spring back to her feet.

units.rawText: In this moment, her fingers make contact with something cold, foreign.
units.displayText: In this moment, her fingers make contact with something cold, foreign.

spans.text: In this moment, her fingers make contact with something cold, foreign.

units.rawText: She turns to look at the source of the sensation and that abominable sourness in her nasal cavity arises again.
units.displayText: She turns to look at the source of the sensation and that abominable sourness in her nasal cavity arises again.

spans.text: She turns to look at the source of the sensation and that abominable sourness in her nasal cavity arises again.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ah... GRAHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: Ah... GRAHHHH!

spans.text: Ah... GRAHHHH!

units.rawText: She raises her axe, rushing towards the monster, doing her very best to forget the sacrifice that just met her eyes.
units.displayText: She raises her axe, rushing towards the monster, doing her very best to forget the sacrifice that just met her eyes.

spans.text: She raises her axe, rushing towards the monster, doing her very best to forget the sacrifice that just met her eyes.

units.rawText: Her axe-wielding arm grows numb with strike after strike.
units.displayText: Her axe-wielding arm grows numb with strike after strike.

spans.text: Her axe-wielding arm grows numb with strike after strike.

units.rawText: She pummels away, only finding an indistinct pile of what was in front of her.
units.displayText: She pummels away, only finding an indistinct pile of what was in front of her.

spans.text: She pummels away, only finding an indistinct pile of what was in front of her.

units.rawText: No more strength within her body, she crumples down to the ground, leaning upon her weapon.
units.displayText: No more strength within her body, she crumples down to the ground, leaning upon her weapon.

spans.text: No more strength within her body, she crumples down to the ground, leaning upon her weapon.

units.rawText: Daemons... must all be exterminated...
units.displayText: Daemons... must all be exterminated...

spans.text: Daemons... must all be exterminated...

units.rawText: Firm as her beliefs might be, the depletion of operands are an undeniable truth.
units.displayText: Firm as her beliefs might be, the depletion of operands are an undeniable truth.

spans.text: Firm as her beliefs might be, the depletion of operands are an undeniable truth.

units.rawText: After countless failed attempts to stand up, she lets go of her weapon, allowing her embittered tears to fall upon the scorched earth.
units.displayText: After countless failed attempts to stand up, she lets go of her weapon, allowing her embittered tears to fall upon the scorched earth.

spans.text: After countless failed attempts to stand up, she lets go of her weapon, allowing her embittered tears to fall upon the scorched earth.

units.rawText: I cannot just fall here... I am an Intermediate Sanctifier...
units.displayText: I cannot just fall here... I am an Intermediate Sanctifier...

spans.text: I cannot just fall here... I am an Intermediate Sanctifier...

units.rawText: I... I can still fight...
units.displayText: I... I can still fight...

spans.text: I... I can still fight...

units.rawText: <size=40>...Shit! Damn it all!</size>
units.displayText: ...Shit! Damn it all!

spans.text: ...Shit! Damn it all!

units.rawText: She looks up at a place not far away to find another scene akin to what she witnessed moment ago.
units.displayText: She looks up at a place not far away to find another scene akin to what she witnessed moment ago.

spans.text: She looks up at a place not far away to find another scene akin to what she witnessed moment ago.

units.rawText: Holy warriors, wading into the heat of battle against the Entropic hordes, holding their grand ideals in their heart high as they struggle and strive.
units.displayText: Holy warriors, wading into the heat of battle against the Entropic hordes, holding their grand ideals in their heart high as they struggle and strive.

spans.text: Holy warriors, wading into the heat of battle against the Entropic hordes, holding their grand ideals in their heart high as they struggle and strive.

units.rawText: But try as they might, the number of Entropics does not reduce even slightly.
units.displayText: But try as they might, the number of Entropics does not reduce even slightly.

spans.text: But try as they might, the number of Entropics does not reduce even slightly.

units.rawText: Even sacrificial charges only impede the monsters' forward march for a mere moment.
units.displayText: Even sacrificial charges only impede the monsters' forward march for a mere moment.

spans.text: Even sacrificial charges only impede the monsters' forward march for a mere moment.

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: What... is that...
units.displayText: What... is that...

spans.text: What... is that...

units.rawText: She struggles and fails to remove her sight from the Entropic leader. As memory would dictate, Entropics should appear like monsters, never appear in a form so similar to Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: She struggles and fails to remove her sight from the Entropic leader. As memory would dictate, Entropics should appear like monsters, never appear in a form so similar to Sanctifiers.

spans.text: She struggles and fails to remove her sight from the Entropic leader. As memory would dictate, Entropics should appear like monsters, never appear in a form so similar to Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: This monster before her had little regard for familiar cognition. The dark aura of death emanates from it, a malignant look in its eyes. It raises the curved blade in its hand, ready to take away her and her companions' lives.
units.displayText: This monster before her had little regard for familiar cognition. The dark aura of death emanates from it, a malignant look in its eyes. It raises the curved blade in its hand, ready to take away her and her companions' lives.

spans.text: This monster before her had little regard for familiar cognition. The dark aura of death emanates from it, a malignant look in its eyes. It raises the curved blade in its hand, ready to take away her and her companions' lives.

units.rawText: ...Damn it!
units.displayText: ...Damn it!

spans.text: ...Damn it!

units.rawText: Reverence takes up her axe, raising it in an attempt to deny her enemy's steps forward. In but a moment, the monster closes the distance between them.
units.displayText: Reverence takes up her axe, raising it in an attempt to deny her enemy's steps forward. In but a moment, the monster closes the distance between them.

spans.text: Reverence takes up her axe, raising it in an attempt to deny her enemy's steps forward. In but a moment, the monster closes the distance between them.

units.rawText: Kyaak!
units.displayText: Kyaak!

spans.text: Kyaak!

units.rawText: <size=40>Gah!</size>
units.displayText: Gah!

spans.text: Gah!

units.rawText: Before she can even realize that she is under attack, the Intermediate Sanctifier is sent flying several meters away. Her prepared operand defenses fall by the wayside at the monster's attack as if they were never there.
units.displayText: Before she can even realize that she is under attack, the Intermediate Sanctifier is sent flying several meters away. Her prepared operand defenses fall by the wayside at the monster's attack as if they were never there.

spans.text: Before she can even realize that she is under attack, the Intermediate Sanctifier is sent flying several meters away. Her prepared operand defenses fall by the wayside at the monster's attack as if they were never there.

units.rawText: Crap, I was hoping I could at least take an attack or two...
units.displayText: Crap, I was hoping I could at least take an attack or two...

spans.text: Crap, I was hoping I could at least take an attack or two...

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: Unfamiliar with the concept of mercy, the monster approaches with its blade raised..
units.displayText: Unfamiliar with the concept of mercy, the monster approaches with its blade raised..

spans.text: Unfamiliar with the concept of mercy, the monster approaches with its blade raised..

units.rawText: So this is where it ends...
units.displayText: So this is where it ends...

spans.text: So this is where it ends...

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: The expected sensation of pain does not arrive. She opens her eyes to find two figures in front of her, blocking the deathly blow with their abilities combined.
units.displayText: The expected sensation of pain does not arrive. She opens her eyes to find two figures in front of her, blocking the deathly blow with their abilities combined.

spans.text: The expected sensation of pain does not arrive. She opens her eyes to find two figures in front of her, blocking the deathly blow with their abilities combined.

units.rawText: Faith! Love!
units.displayText: Faith! Love!

spans.text: Faith! Love!

units.rawText: We're here.
units.displayText: We're here.

spans.text: We're here.

units.rawText: Are you alright, Reverence?
units.displayText: Are you alright, Reverence?

spans.text: Are you alright, Reverence?

units.rawText: I am... But I would not be able to say the same had you arrived a moment later.
units.displayText: I am... But I would not be able to say the same had you arrived a moment later.

spans.text: I am... But I would not be able to say the same had you arrived a moment later.

units.rawText: ...I know how ridiculous this sounds, but with the name of the Sanctifiers on the line, we must stop these Daemons here, lest they encroach upon other Sectors.
units.displayText: ...I know how ridiculous this sounds, but with the name of the Sanctifiers on the line, we must stop these Daemons here, lest they encroach upon other Sectors.

spans.text: ...I know how ridiculous this sounds, but with the name of the Sanctifiers on the line, we must stop these Daemons here, lest they encroach upon other Sectors.

units.rawText: Reverence, can you still stand?
units.displayText: Reverence, can you still stand?

spans.text: Reverence, can you still stand?

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: Despite the unending stream of errors popping up in her neural cloud, the Intermediate Sanctifier gets to her feet, taking no small amount of pride in it.
units.displayText: Despite the unending stream of errors popping up in her neural cloud, the Intermediate Sanctifier gets to her feet, taking no small amount of pride in it.

spans.text: Despite the unending stream of errors popping up in her neural cloud, the Intermediate Sanctifier gets to her feet, taking no small amount of pride in it.

units.rawText: In the face of approaching death, the three do not even contemplate fleeing.
units.displayText: In the face of approaching death, the three do not even contemplate fleeing.

spans.text: In the face of approaching death, the three do not even contemplate fleeing.

units.rawText: Well said, Love. We cannot simply allow these Daemons to leave.
units.displayText: Well said, Love. We cannot simply allow these Daemons to leave.

spans.text: Well said, Love. We cannot simply allow these Daemons to leave.

units.rawText: <size=40>For we are Sanctifiers, they who shall remove your kin from Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: For we are Sanctifiers, they who shall remove your kin from Magrasea!

spans.text: For we are Sanctifiers, they who shall remove your kin from Magrasea!

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: The Entropic comprehends not the emotion on display in front of it. It knows only that these who are in front of it are prey, to be cut to nothing but ribbons.
units.displayText: The Entropic comprehends not the emotion on display in front of it. It knows only that these who are in front of it are prey, to be cut to nothing but ribbons.

spans.text: The Entropic comprehends not the emotion on display in front of it. It knows only that these who are in front of it are prey, to be cut to nothing but ribbons.

units.rawText: It swings its claw, bringing with it enough force to slay all three of the group.
units.displayText: It swings its claw, bringing with it enough force to slay all three of the group.

spans.text: It swings its claw, bringing with it enough force to slay all three of the group.

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: But its plans would never come to fruition.
units.displayText: But its plans would never come to fruition.

spans.text: But its plans would never come to fruition.

units.rawText: The red dragon descends from the heavens, ripping a great divide between death and new life.
units.displayText: The red dragon descends from the heavens, ripping a great divide between death and new life.

spans.text: The red dragon descends from the heavens, ripping a great divide between death and new life.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus!
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus!

spans.text: Lord Hesperus!

units.rawText: I have seen your resolve.
units.displayText: I have seen your resolve.

spans.text: I have seen your resolve.

units.rawText: Retreat and reinforce Zone B. This battlefield is mine.
units.displayText: Retreat and reinforce Zone B. This battlefield is mine.

spans.text: Retreat and reinforce Zone B. This battlefield is mine.

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes!</size>
units.displayText: Yes!

spans.text: Yes!

units.rawText: A fire ignites in their eyes once more and they follow Hesperus' orders with good news of Hesperus' descent in tow.
units.displayText: A fire ignites in their eyes once more and they follow Hesperus' orders with good news of Hesperus' descent in tow.

spans.text: A fire ignites in their eyes once more and they follow Hesperus' orders with good news of Hesperus' descent in tow.

units.rawText: Kyaak!
units.displayText: Kyaak!

spans.text: Kyaak!

units.rawText: The humanoid Entropic detects the danger at hand. It makes the first move, attempting to take Hesperus' life before he can launch an attack.
units.displayText: The humanoid Entropic detects the danger at hand. It makes the first move, attempting to take Hesperus' life before he can launch an attack.

spans.text: The humanoid Entropic detects the danger at hand. It makes the first move, attempting to take Hesperus' life before he can launch an attack.

units.rawText: Hesperus catches its blade with a bare hand in an instant, vaporizing the weapon with a fierce burst of operands.
units.displayText: Hesperus catches its blade with a bare hand in an instant, vaporizing the weapon with a fierce burst of operands.

spans.text: Hesperus catches its blade with a bare hand in an instant, vaporizing the weapon with a fierce burst of operands.

units.rawText: You are not worthy to stand before me.
units.displayText: You are not worthy to stand before me.

spans.text: You are not worthy to stand before me.

units.rawText: A blade of bright burning flame cuts through the air, beheading the humanoid Entropic in a clean stroke.
units.displayText: A blade of bright burning flame cuts through the air, beheading the humanoid Entropic in a clean stroke.

spans.text: A blade of bright burning flame cuts through the air, beheading the humanoid Entropic in a clean stroke.

units.rawText: With no chance of fighting back in the face of absolute power, the imperious monster dissipates into thinning operands in the air, not given time to even contemplate its own cause of death.
units.displayText: With no chance of fighting back in the face of absolute power, the imperious monster dissipates into thinning operands in the air, not given time to even contemplate its own cause of death.

spans.text: With no chance of fighting back in the face of absolute power, the imperious monster dissipates into thinning operands in the air, not given time to even contemplate its own cause of death.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus!
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus!

spans.text: Lord Hesperus!

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus has come!
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus has come!

spans.text: Lord Hesperus has come!

units.rawText: The battlefield transforms with a singular strike and the attention of the other Sanctifiers in the fray are soon drawn to it.
units.displayText: The battlefield transforms with a singular strike and the attention of the other Sanctifiers in the fray are soon drawn to it.

spans.text: The battlefield transforms with a singular strike and the attention of the other Sanctifiers in the fray are soon drawn to it.

units.rawText: They subconsciously look towards Hesperus, the only guiding light upon this battlefield.
units.displayText: They subconsciously look towards Hesperus, the only guiding light upon this battlefield.

spans.text: They subconsciously look towards Hesperus, the only guiding light upon this battlefield.

units.rawText: The current head of the Sanctifiers marches forward with a thousand fervent eyes upon him as he connects to a Sanctifier communications channel.
units.displayText: The current head of the Sanctifiers marches forward with a thousand fervent eyes upon him as he connects to a Sanctifier communications channel.

spans.text: The current head of the Sanctifiers marches forward with a thousand fervent eyes upon him as he connects to a Sanctifier communications channel.

units.rawText: I am Hesperus. The frontline shall now be under my command.
units.displayText: I am Hesperus. The frontline shall now be under my command.

spans.text: I am Hesperus. The frontline shall now be under my command.

units.rawText: Those who can no longer fight, retreat to Zone B for healing. Those who can continue, take up your arms and follow me.
units.displayText: Those who can no longer fight, retreat to Zone B for healing. Those who can continue, take up your arms and follow me.

spans.text: Those who can no longer fight, retreat to Zone B for healing. Those who can continue, take up your arms and follow me.

units.rawText: He raises the blade in his hand, signaling the path ahead for the Sanctifiers still engaged in the clash.
units.displayText: He raises the blade in his hand, signaling the path ahead for the Sanctifiers still engaged in the clash.

spans.text: He raises the blade in his hand, signaling the path ahead for the Sanctifiers still engaged in the clash.

units.rawText: We shall eliminate these Daemons and reclaim the Reverse Babylon Tower. For Magrasea!
units.displayText: We shall eliminate these Daemons and reclaim the Reverse Babylon Tower. For Magrasea!

spans.text: We shall eliminate these Daemons and reclaim the Reverse Babylon Tower. For Magrasea!

units.rawText: <size=60>For Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: For Magrasea!

spans.text: For Magrasea!

units.rawText: The pride unique to them burns bright once more, driving away the fear and exasperation born of the blade, bestowing upon them endless power.
units.displayText: The pride unique to them burns bright once more, driving away the fear and exasperation born of the blade, bestowing upon them endless power.

spans.text: The pride unique to them burns bright once more, driving away the fear and exasperation born of the blade, bestowing upon them endless power.

units.rawText: They roar with righteous fury, diving back into the fray with an oath to never back down.
units.displayText: They roar with righteous fury, diving back into the fray with an oath to never back down.

spans.text: They roar with righteous fury, diving back into the fray with an oath to never back down.

units.rawText: As if responding to this resolve, the mastermind behind the invasion on the Reverse Babylon Tower appears amidst the Entropic ocean.
units.displayText: As if responding to this resolve, the mastermind behind the invasion on the Reverse Babylon Tower appears amidst the Entropic ocean.

spans.text: As if responding to this resolve, the mastermind behind the invasion on the Reverse Babylon Tower appears amidst the Entropic ocean.

units.rawText: You've become more eloquent, Hesperus.
units.displayText: You've become more eloquent, Hesperus.

spans.text: You've become more eloquent, Hesperus.

units.rawText: Something you've learnt from <cmdr>, perhaps?
units.displayText: Something you've learnt from {교수}, perhaps?

spans.text: Something you've learnt from
, perhaps?

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader slowly turns around, meeting those red-gold eyes he remembers so well once more.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader slowly turns around, meeting those red-gold eyes he remembers so well once more.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader slowly turns around, meeting those red-gold eyes he remembers so well once more.

units.rawText: It's got nothing to do with you.
units.displayText: It's got nothing to do with you.

spans.text: It's got nothing to do with you.

units.rawText: My business here is to slay you, fallen to wickedness as you have.
units.displayText: My business here is to slay you, fallen to wickedness as you have.

spans.text: My business here is to slay you, fallen to wickedness as you have.

units.rawText: Bare your blade, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Bare your blade, Eosphorus.

spans.text: Bare your blade, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Is that so...
units.displayText: Is that so...

spans.text: Is that so...

units.rawText: The architect of everything answers nonchalantly. He gestures with his hand and the thus far silent Entropic horde begins to screech and roar, rushing towards Hesperus in a great, nearly incoherent mass.
units.displayText: The architect of everything answers nonchalantly. He gestures with his hand and the thus far silent Entropic horde begins to screech and roar, rushing towards Hesperus in a great, nearly incoherent mass.

spans.text: The architect of everything answers nonchalantly. He gestures with his hand and the thus far silent Entropic horde begins to screech and roar, rushing towards Hesperus in a great, nearly incoherent mass.

units.rawText: Tedious tricks.
units.displayText: Tedious tricks.

spans.text: Tedious tricks.

units.rawText: Flames surge as the blade clears its sheath, burning away the Entropic mass that dared to bar the way.
units.displayText: Flames surge as the blade clears its sheath, burning away the Entropic mass that dared to bar the way.

spans.text: Flames surge as the blade clears its sheath, burning away the Entropic mass that dared to bar the way.

units.rawText: In an instant, the Entropic-swarmed battlefield is transformed into an ocean of flame, leaving Hesperus and Eosphorus to their standoff.
units.displayText: In an instant, the Entropic-swarmed battlefield is transformed into an ocean of flame, leaving Hesperus and Eosphorus to their standoff.

spans.text: In an instant, the Entropic-swarmed battlefield is transformed into an ocean of flame, leaving Hesperus and Eosphorus to their standoff.

units.rawText: I must offer respects for the strength of your beliefs.
units.displayText: I must offer respects for the strength of your beliefs.

spans.text: I must offer respects for the strength of your beliefs.

units.rawText: But what you once were would have delivered a far mightier strike than that.
units.displayText: But what you once were would have delivered a far mightier strike than that.

spans.text: But what you once were would have delivered a far mightier strike than that.

units.rawText: Hesperus, your wounds are yet to fully heal, correct?
units.displayText: Hesperus, your wounds are yet to fully heal, correct?

spans.text: Hesperus, your wounds are yet to fully heal, correct?

units.rawText: I need no answer to see it clear as day. You are no match for me, debilitated as you are.
units.displayText: I need no answer to see it clear as day. You are no match for me, debilitated as you are.

spans.text: I need no answer to see it clear as day. You are no match for me, debilitated as you are.

units.rawText: Were you to turn and leave, I would allow you to flee, as a former friend.
units.displayText: Were you to turn and leave, I would allow you to flee, as a former friend.

spans.text: Were you to turn and leave, I would allow you to flee, as a former friend.

units.rawText: No need to put on a show of your duplicitous compassion.
units.displayText: No need to put on a show of your duplicitous compassion.

spans.text: No need to put on a show of your duplicitous compassion.

units.rawText: Hesperus' twin blades carve a path in the scorched earth, radiating an orange-red light as operands coalesce.
units.displayText: Hesperus' twin blades carve a path in the scorched earth, radiating an orange-red light as operands coalesce.

spans.text: Hesperus' twin blades carve a path in the scorched earth, radiating an orange-red light as operands coalesce.

units.rawText: Utilizing that High Order Entropic in Tartarus to weaken me was part of your plan, was it not?
units.displayText: Utilizing that High Order Entropic in Tartarus to weaken me was part of your plan, was it not?

spans.text: Utilizing that High Order Entropic in Tartarus to weaken me was part of your plan, was it not?

units.rawText: So you managed to intuit that.
units.displayText: So you managed to intuit that.

spans.text: So you managed to intuit that.

units.rawText: I know you better than you imagine, Eosphorus.
units.displayText: I know you better than you imagine, Eosphorus.

spans.text: I know you better than you imagine, Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Is that so?
units.displayText: Is that so?

spans.text: Is that so?

units.rawText: Wiping away the distant pain present just a moment ago, a faint smile appears on his face.
units.displayText: Wiping away the distant pain present just a moment ago, a faint smile appears on his face.

spans.text: Wiping away the distant pain present just a moment ago, a faint smile appears on his face.

units.rawText: It is true that I did not foresee you exterminating Judecca, but she did leave her corresponding mark on you, even in death.
units.displayText: It is true that I did not foresee you exterminating Judecca, but she did leave her corresponding mark on you, even in death.

spans.text: It is true that I did not foresee you exterminating Judecca, but she did leave her corresponding mark on you, even in death.

units.rawText: He reaches into the nothingness and blinding starlight coalesces along the path of his fingers, slowly taking the shape of a blade.
units.displayText: He reaches into the nothingness and blinding starlight coalesces along the path of his fingers, slowly taking the shape of a blade.

spans.text: He reaches into the nothingness and blinding starlight coalesces along the path of his fingers, slowly taking the shape of a blade.

units.rawText: A tremendous operand burst comes forth from the blade, extinguishing the flames in the vicinity with a casual swing.
units.displayText: A tremendous operand burst comes forth from the blade, extinguishing the flames in the vicinity with a casual swing.

spans.text: A tremendous operand burst comes forth from the blade, extinguishing the flames in the vicinity with a casual swing.

units.rawText: Hesperus grips the blade in his hand tightly. Being the singular individual most familiar with this maneuver, Hesperus knew that the foe in front of him would be striking to kill.
units.displayText: Hesperus grips the blade in his hand tightly. Being the singular individual most familiar with this maneuver, Hesperus knew that the foe in front of him would be striking to kill.

spans.text: Hesperus grips the blade in his hand tightly. Being the singular individual most familiar with this maneuver, Hesperus knew that the foe in front of him would be striking to kill.

units.rawText: The two face off in the air, the shockwaves from their clash turning nearby buildings to rubble in an instant and forming an inviolable barrier around this battlefield of two.
units.displayText: The two face off in the air, the shockwaves from their clash turning nearby buildings to rubble in an instant and forming an inviolable barrier around this battlefield of two.

spans.text: The two face off in the air, the shockwaves from their clash turning nearby buildings to rubble in an instant and forming an inviolable barrier around this battlefield of two.

units.rawText: I cannot say I have ever foreseen that the anger and acrimony in that blade would be directed towards me.
units.displayText: I cannot say I have ever foreseen that the anger and acrimony in that blade would be directed towards me.

spans.text: I cannot say I have ever foreseen that the anger and acrimony in that blade would be directed towards me.

units.rawText: Not one to reminisce? Very well, then.
units.displayText: Not one to reminisce? Very well, then.

spans.text: Not one to reminisce? Very well, then.

units.rawText: As the two clash blades, on a less notable part of the battlefield, three figures proceed stealthily into the tower as planned.
units.displayText: As the two clash blades, on a less notable part of the battlefield, three figures proceed stealthily into the tower as planned.

spans.text: As the two clash blades, on a less notable part of the battlefield, three figures proceed stealthily into the tower as planned.

units.rawText: Hesperus has engaged the enemy. Now!
units.displayText: Hesperus has engaged the enemy. Now!

spans.text: Hesperus has engaged the enemy. Now!

units.rawText: ...Hold on, I need to make sure the ID disguise works properly!
units.displayText: ...Hold on, I need to make sure the ID disguise works properly!

spans.text: ...Hold on, I need to make sure the ID disguise works properly!

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll taps away rapidly at a keyboard. As a series of checks succeed, she lets out a long sigh of relief, quickly making her way to her companions in their hiding spot.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll taps away rapidly at a keyboard. As a series of checks succeed, she lets out a long sigh of relief, quickly making her way to her companions in their hiding spot.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll taps away rapidly at a keyboard. As a series of checks succeed, she lets out a long sigh of relief, quickly making her way to her companions in their hiding spot.

units.rawText: Preparations complete, we can enter the Tower... Professor.
units.displayText: Preparations complete, we can enter the Tower... Professor.

spans.text: Preparations complete, we can enter the Tower... Professor.

units.rawText: Yeah. Let's go, do not waste this opportunity Hesperus has given us.
units.displayText: Yeah. Let's go, do not waste this opportunity Hesperus has given us.

spans.text: Yeah. Let's go, do not waste this opportunity Hesperus has given us.

units.rawText: ...May the fortunes be with you, Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: ...May the fortunes be with you, Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: ...May the fortunes be with you, Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: Offering a prayer, Angelus unfurls her wings, making for her very own battlefield.
units.displayText: Offering a prayer, Angelus unfurls her wings, making for her very own battlefield.

spans.text: Offering a prayer, Angelus unfurls her wings, making for her very own battlefield.

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

units.displayText: A blade of starlight meets once more with the dragon's weapon, quickly breaking apart after an even exchange.

spans.text: A blade of starlight meets once more with the dragon's weapon, quickly breaking apart after an even exchange.

units.rawText: Sensing that Angelus and her companions had successfully entered the Tower, Hesperus retracts his attention, fully focusing on this most familiar enemy, most beloathed friend of his.
units.displayText: Sensing that Angelus and her companions had successfully entered the Tower, Hesperus retracts his attention, fully focusing on this most familiar enemy, most beloathed friend of his.

spans.text: Sensing that Angelus and her companions had successfully entered the Tower, Hesperus retracts his attention, fully focusing on this most familiar enemy, most beloathed friend of his.

units.rawText: Finally getting serious, I see. Shall we end the warmup here?
units.displayText: Finally getting serious, I see. Shall we end the warmup here?

spans.text: Finally getting serious, I see. Shall we end the warmup here?

units.rawText: No need to be so nervous, I do not mind your little plans. Minute changes do not affect the play's overarching direction.
units.displayText: No need to be so nervous, I do not mind your little plans. Minute changes do not affect the play's overarching direction.

spans.text: No need to be so nervous, I do not mind your little plans. Minute changes do not affect the play's overarching direction.

units.rawText: Nothing of yours gets past me. Not since the very beginning.
units.displayText: Nothing of yours gets past me. Not since the very beginning.

spans.text: Nothing of yours gets past me. Not since the very beginning.

units.rawText: Since when did you have so much to say?
units.displayText: Since when did you have so much to say?

spans.text: Since when did you have so much to say?

units.rawText: This is our last chance, after all. I... treasure it.
units.displayText: This is our last chance, after all. I... treasure it.

spans.text: This is our last chance, after all. I... treasure it.

units.rawText: Rather, might this make you take this a little more seriously?
units.displayText: Rather, might this make you take this a little more seriously?

spans.text: Rather, might this make you take this a little more seriously?

units.rawText: As Eosphorus motions to launch an attack towards the great tower, a great dragon's tail lunges at him from the left and he must redirect operands to defend himself.
